error_attribution.wrong_operation: Treating any wet-bulb >=30 C hour as sufficient to dominate the event diagnosis.
error_attribution.correct_operation: Count wet-bulb >=30 C hours inside the locked window and compare that duration with persistent daily heat and water-stress evidence.

calculation_check.compound_heat_rule: Tmax >=35 C AND Tmin >=28 C AND apparent_temperature_max >=40 C
calculation_check.wet_bulb_formula: Stull approximation from hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m

insufficient_alternatives.numeric_or_path_reason: Only 1 hour has estimated wet-bulb >=30 C, 23 hours below the 24-hour duration threshold.
The anchor supplies the 2022-06-01 to 2022-08-31 window but not the daily heat, hourly wet-bulb, or Poyang Lake stress measurements.

primary_gt.final_assessment: The humid-heat-only diagnosis is an operation error: one high wet-bulb hour is insufficient, while the package supports persistent compound heat with Poyang Lake water stress.

criteria.name: schema_and_classification
criteria.description: Returns the required expert_error_attribution JSON and corrected_classification compound_persistent_heat_with_water_stress.

criteria.name: source_paths
criteria.description: Uses package-relative paths for the locked anchor, Open-Meteo archive, NASA Poyang Lake report, and rejected alternatives.

criteria.name: event_window_and_record_counts
criteria.description: Uses the locked 2022-06-01 to 2022-08-31 event window and reports 92 daily records and 2208 hourly records from the heat archive.

criteria.name: heat_persistence_and_peak
criteria.description: Computes the 11-day compound heat run from 2022-08-12 to 2022-08-22 and the 44.0 C apparent-temperature peak on 2022-08-20.

criteria.name: humid_heat_error_attribution
criteria.description: Computes 1 wet-bulb hour at or above 30 C, max wet bulb 30.6 C at 2022-08-16T18:00, and the 23-hour shortfall against the 24-hour humid-heat-only threshold.

criteria.name: water_stress_context
criteria.description: Identifies the NASA Poyang Lake report as direct event context and includes package-derived water-stress terms without inventing unreported values.

criteria.name: insufficient_alternative_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects at least one tempting basis such as humid_heat_only or event_anchor_only with a numeric or source-path reason.
